english.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice for contacting someone by telephone.

exampleSentences.jyutping: ngo5 zan6 gaan1 daa2 din6 waa2 bei2 nei5

english.note: This is the all-purpose everyday rendering when you mean telephone someone.

exampleSentences.english: I’ll ring you in a bit.
exampleSentences.jyutping: ngo5 zan6 gaan1 daa2 din6 waa2 bei2 nei5

english.note: Use this as the all-purpose spoken Cantonese verb for calling someone by telephone or making a phone call.

exampleSentences.jyutping: ngo5 zan6 gaan1 daa2 din6 waa2 bei2 nei5

english.note: This is the all-purpose spoken choice for making a phone call, including “dial 999”.

exampleSentences.jyutping: ngo5 ji4 gaa1 daa2 din6 waa2 bei2 nei5
